name: money-count-burst
title: Money Count Burst
description: A big amount counts from zero up to a target, turns green with a flash, and bursts into bills and coins.
useWhen: A revenue, savings or payout number should count up and end on a celebratory burst.
The scene is about money and a clean light look suits it.
avoidWhen: The number should stay calm and readable with no celebration: use a count-up block.
You need the sound effect that upstream ships.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
